name: Klook
desc: Asia-Pacific online platform for booking travel experiences, attractions, event tickets, rail and transport, serving travellers and thousands of merchants.
products: attraction and event tickets, tours, rail passes, car rental, merchant software
customers: leisure travellers; merchants and destination partners
marketing_autonomy_basis: independent company with its own VP Global Marketing (newsroom)
markets: Asia-Pacific core (Hong Kong, Singapore, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, South-East Asia) with approx. 1,900 employees located internationally
expansion_markets: concert, sport and entertainment ticketing named as growth area in F-1

fin.value_orig: adjusted EBITDA USD 6.3m (nine months to 30 Sep 2025)

profitability_basis: F-1 risk factor: history of net losses; adjusted EBITDA turned positive (USD 6.3m) in 9M 2025

signals.what: Filed F-1 for US IPO (Nov 2025); registration withdrawal request filed 16 Oct 2026, company statement on its IPO registration
Exclusive ticketing partner for Disney D23 Asia in Singapore
MoU with Visa across six South-East Asian markets
Launched K.ai AI agent for merchants; partnership with Meta Muse in Japan

fit_rationale: Experiences and event-ticketing platform whose users travel to Singapore, Japan, China and Gulf races; F1 rights could feed race-weekend packages, ticketing and creator content.
f1_markets: Singapore, Japan, China, Australia, Abu Dhabi, Qatar
outstanding: Latest valuation and total equity raised (not in pages opened).
